 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>NEWS RELEASE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>For immediate release </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right">Kathryn McKie </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right">904 598 7348 </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right">KathrynMcKie@regencycenters.com </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Regency Centers Prices $450 Million Senior Unsecured Notes Offering </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>JACKSONVILLE, Fla.</B> (February 18, 2026) &#8211; Regency Centers Corporation (&#8220;Regency,&#8221; &#8220;Regency Centers,&#8221; or the
&#8220;Company&#8221;) (Nasdaq: REG) announced today that its operating partnership, Regency Centers, L.P., has priced a $450&nbsp;million public offering of senior unsecured notes due 2033 (the &#8220;Notes&#8221;) under its existing shelf
registration filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;). The Notes will mature on March&nbsp;15, 2033, and were issued at 99.376% of par value with a coupon of 4.50%. Interest on the Notes will be payable
semiannually on September&nbsp;15 and March&nbsp;15 of each year, with the first payment due and payable on September&nbsp;15, 2026. The Company will guarantee the payment of principal and interest on the Notes. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Regency intends to use the net proceeds of the offering (i)&nbsp;to reduce the outstanding balance on its line of credit, (ii)&nbsp;for the repayment of the
$100&nbsp;million aggregate principal amount outstanding of 3.81% notes due May&nbsp;11, 2026 upon their maturity and (iii)&nbsp;for general corporate purposes, including, but not limited to, prefunding certain capital expenditures, development and
redevelopment projects and the future repayment of other outstanding debt. Settlement of the offering is subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions and is expected to occur on February&nbsp;23, 2026. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">BofA Securities, Inc., J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, U.S. Bancorp Investments, Inc., Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, PNC Capital Markets LLC, RBC Capital Markets,
LLC and Scotia Capital (USA) Inc. are acting as joint book-running managers. BMO Capital Markets Corp., BNY Mellon Capital Markets, LLC, Mizuho Securities USA LLC, Regions Securities LLC, TD Securities (USA) LLC and Truist Securities, Inc. are
acting as senior <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">co-managers.</FONT> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Regency and Regency Centers, L.P. have jointly filed a registration statement
(including a prospectus and related prospectus supplement) with the SEC with respect to the offering of the Notes. Before you invest, you should read the prospectus in that registration statement and the prospectus supplement for the offering, as
well as the other documents Regency and Regency Centers, L.P. have filed with the SEC for more complete information about Regency and Regency Centers, L.P. and the offering. You may obtain these documents for free by visiting EDGAR on the SEC
website at http://www.sec.gov. Alternatively, by calling BofA Securities, Inc. at <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">1-800-294-1322,</FONT></FONT></FONT> J.P. Morgan Securities LLC at <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">1-212-834-4533,</FONT></FONT></FONT> U.S. Bancorp Investments, Inc. at <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">1-877-558-2607</FONT></FONT></FONT> or Wells Fargo Securities, LLC at <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">1-800-645-3751,</FONT></FONT></FONT> or, such
underwriter will arrange to send you the registration statement, prospectus and the related prospectus supplement upon your request. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This press release
does not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy any security and shall not constitute an offer, solicitation or sale in any jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful. </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>About Regency Centers Corporation (Nasdaq: REG) </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Regency Centers is a preeminent national owner, operator, and developer of shopping centers located in suburban trade areas with compelling demographics. Our
portfolio includes thriving properties merchandised with highly productive grocers, restaurants, service providers, and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">best-in-class</FONT></FONT> retailers that connect to their
neighborhoods, communities, and customers. Operating as a fully integrated real estate company, Regency Centers is a qualified real estate investment trust (REIT) that is self-administered, self-managed, and an S&amp;P 500 Index member. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">### </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Forward-Looking Statements </B></P>
